note: vefl_bef is a VEFL submodule adding the Views exposed form style 'vefl_bef' (Better Exposed Filters (with layout)); class VeflBef extends BEF's BetterExposedFilters and uses VeflTrait. It requires vefl + better_exposed_filters. Config lives in a view's display_options.exposed_form: type=vefl_bef, options.layout {layout_id (vefl_onecol ships), widget_region: {<widget_id>: <region_id>}} plus the BEF options.bef tree. Extra region-assignable items over vefl_basic: 'secondary' and 'sort_bef_combine'. NOTE the site currently cannot enable vefl_bef because full module install / entity save is blocked by an unrelated pre-existing commerce_giftcard pending entity update; the eval setup/reset scripts therefore write the view via the config API (which works), and verify reads the exposed_form config back - the assertions are on config strings, not on a running plugin instance.

evals.prompt: I use Better Exposed Filters and want to arrange its widgets into layout regions. Which Views exposed form style does vefl_bef add and what is its plugin id?
evals.expected_output: vefl_bef adds the exposed form style 'Better Exposed Filters (with layout)', plugin id vefl_bef (class VeflBef extends BEF's BetterExposedFilters and uses VeflTrait).

evals.prompt: What modules must be enabled to use the vefl_bef (Better Exposed Filters Layout) exposed form style?
evals.expected_output: vefl_bef depends on both vefl and better_exposed_filters (plus views).

evals.prompt: Beyond the normal filters and actions, which two BEF-specific items can vefl_bef assign to a layout region, and when do they appear?
evals.expected_output: It adds 'secondary' (Secondary exposed form options, shown when BEF allow_secondary is enabled) and 'sort_bef_combine' (Combine sort order with sort by, shown when BEF's combined sort is enabled) as region-assignable widgets.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a view named 'vefl_bef_known'. Inspect its live configuration and state which exposed form style (plugin) and layout its exposed form uses.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vefl_bef_known uses exposed_form type vefl_bef with options.layout.layout_id = vefl_onecol.

evals.prompt: The view 'vefl_bef_region' on this site lays out its Better Exposed Filters form with vefl_bef. Inspect the live configuration and state which layout region the exposed 'title' widget is assigned to.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.vefl_bef_region the exposed_form (type vefl_bef) has options.layout.widget_region.title = 'middle'.

evals.prompt: The view 'vefl_bef_task' currently uses the plain 'Basic' Views exposed form. Change it to the vefl_bef 'Better Exposed Filters (with layout)' style using the vefl_onecol layout, and apply the change to the live site.

The view 'vefl_bef_assign' already uses the vefl_bef exposed form style, but its exposed 'title' filter is not placed in any region. Assign the 'title' widget to the 'middle' region and apply the change live.
